derivation: from an unused root apparently meaning to be moist;
def: properly, dripping; hence, fresh (i.e. recently made such)

occurrences.text: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.
From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
